articles.title: Crypto catches its breath as bitcoin settles into a holding pattern amid July rally
articles.snippet: BTC is rangebound between $64,000 and $66,800 after a 13% recovery from July's lows, with macro markets offering little direction and WLFI the session's surprise standout at +12%.

articles.title: South Korea's oldest crypto exchange is now part of the $1 trillion Mirae Group family
articles.snippet: Korbit, South Korea's first cryptocurrency exchange, has joined the Mirae Asset Group family, marking the first time a traditional Korean financial group's affiliate has taken a controlling stake in a domestic crypto exchange.

articles.title: Arbitrum-based AFX Trade drained of $24 million after bridge keys compromised
articles.snippet: Security firms said the attacker used enough hot-validator signatures to approve a 24.15 million USDC withdrawal, while Arbitrum said its native bridge was not affected.

articles.title: Binance joins STOP THE TRAFFIK in anti-human trafficking effort
articles.snippet: The partnership expands Binance’s compliance efforts by providing intelligence and training to help detect cryptocurrency activity tied to human trafficking and child exploitation.

articles.title: Coinbase to expand Singapore office headcount by 25%: Report
articles.snippet: Coinbase plans to expand its Singapore office from 150 to about 200 employees by the end of 2026 as it expands its presence in the Lion City.
